name: vc-secrets
description: MCP secret launcher. An MCP server entry stores a call to this launcher instead of a credential: the secret is resolved from the OS credential store (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / gpg) or Azure Key Vault at launch time and injected into that one child process only, so no plaintext token sits in .mcp.json, in ~/.claude.json, in a settings env block or in a .env file. Declarations live in three homes — committed per repo, gitignored per repo, and per user — and carry no secret values, so they are reviewable. Ships no MCP servers of its own: each server is declared by whoever needs it.
